items.name: Fizz canister
items.does: Keeps fizz contained; the language description says it prevents spilling. Its machine component is a Fizz canister energy member.
use: Place it as a machine and connect it to a Fizz energy network.
tips: The active-area rules apply to machine processing.

items.name: Squeak-crank
items.does: Turning the crank produces Fizz; the energy code registers it as a crank machine.
use: Place it, then use the crank interaction to turn it; connect its output to a Fizz network.
tips: Only a running machine produces energy.

items.name: Riftmoth Wing
items.does: A Riftmoth drop item; its language description calls it brittle and void-touched.
use: Use it only in a recipe or system that accepts this item; no such consumer is identified in the inspected sources.
tips: The Riftmoth drop definition gives one wing.

items.name: Scrap plating
items.does: A crafted plating material. Harmony recognizes Scrap Plating as a matching block for a Well whose taste is Scrap.
use: Place the plating block near a Glimmerwell Cradle to contribute to harmony.
tips: Harmony checks a 9-by-9-by-9 area around the Cradle, excluding the Cradle and the Well above it.

items.name: Glimmer Dust
items.does: A Glimmer Wisp drop; the language description identifies it as light shed by a wisp.
use: No item-specific use action is defined in the inspected sources.
tips: The drop definition allows one or two Dust.

items.name: Gold Grit
items.does: The item has a furnace processing recipe that consumes one Gold Grit and outputs one Ingredient_Bar_Gold.
use: Put one Gold Grit into the furnace recipe to produce one Gold Bar.
tips: The listed recipe processes Grit; it does not produce the Grit.

items.name: Muffler
items.does: When installed as a bodge, it suppresses machine rattling.
use: Crouch and use it on a compatible machine; crouch-use toggles installation/removal.
tips: Machines support at most two bodges.

items.name: Gob-Jar
obtain: Drop: Goblin Poacher (weighted drop entry; weight 10)
items.does: An empty jar used to capture a Tethered Glimmerwell. Capture requires three presses, with 0.2-2 seconds between consecutive presses.
use: With the empty jar held, interact with a Tethered Well three times; keep each interval between 4 and 2 seconds.
tips: The press timing is interval-based, not aligned to a Well pulse.

items.name: Wakebell Anchor
items.does: A fueled Anchor keeps nearby chunks loaded; its default maximum charge is 240 minutes. The Anchor refreshes a 3-by-3 chunk area around itself.
use: Place the Anchor and insert charge/fuel through its configured interaction; keep it fueled to maintain chunk loading.
tips: When charge reaches zero or the configured maximum is zero, the Anchor releases its keep-loaded chunks.

items.name: Fizz charge
items.does: Burns for 10 seconds when used as a boiler fuel item.
use: Insert it into a Gutter Boiler fuel slot.
tips: The charge is consumed as fuel; no recipe, shop trade, or drop source is listed in the extraction.

items.name: Storm Vane
items.does: A Storm Vane within 64 blocks contributes to the Stormcall chance of a Steady Well; each vane adds 0.10 to the base 0.15 chance, capped at 0.55.
use: Place the vane within 64 blocks of a Stormcall strike position.
tips: Only recognized storm weather activates the vane; other weather IDs are not storm.

items.name: Snatcher Claw
items.does: The Claw filters transported items by item ID or daub colour. With no item held, its filter is cleared.
use: Use a paint daub on the Claw to set its colour filter; use an item to set an item-ID filter; use an empty hand to clear the filter.
tips: Only its owner crew or a permitted user may configure it.

items.name: Squint Goggles
items.does: An equipment item; its language description says it helps the wearer see details.
use: Wear the goggles in the equipment slot.
tips: No numerical vision range is specified in the inspected sources.

items.name: Yellow paint daub
items.does: Marks a Gutterpipe branch yellow.
use: Use it on the target Gutterpipe branch; the daub interaction sets the pipe colour.
tips: Colour affects pipe routing; the code recognizes red, blue, green, and yellow.

items.name: Gnasher Pit
items.does: A buildable machine with a dedicated notebook page and energy member.
use: Place it as a machine and use its configured block interaction.
tips: Crafting is blocked until the crew has the matching Gnasher notebook page.

items.name: Fizz Damper
items.does: A Damper can calm a Well; the runtime transitions a smothered Well to DORMANT and reduces its strength band.
use: Place and activate it beside a Well using its block interaction.
tips: Well state changes are persisted by the Well block entity.

items.name: Scorch Oven
items.does: Processes recipes using Fizz fuel; the configured oven fuel drop is Fizz Charge.
use: Place it, add a supported recipe's inputs and Fizz fuel, then let its machine process while the area is active.
tips: Oven crafting requires the matching notebook page.

items.name: Prisma Grit
items.does: The furnace processing recipe consumes one Prisma Grit and outputs one Ingredient_Bar_Prisma.
use: Put one Prisma Grit into the furnace recipe to produce one Prisma Bar.
tips: The listed recipe processes Grit; it does not produce the Grit.

items.name: Catch Net
items.does: The Hurl Cannon description identifies the Catch Net as a landing target, and the Catch Net description calls it a soft landing.
use: Place it as the landing target for a Hurl Cannon; the Hurl Cannon description requires a Catch Net within 64 blocks.
tips: The Hurl Cannon description says its Boom Powder charges are coming soon.

items.name: Cobalt Grit
items.does: The furnace processing recipe consumes one Cobalt Grit and outputs one Ingredient_Bar_Cobalt.
use: Put one Cobalt Grit into the furnace recipe to produce one Cobalt Bar.
tips: The listed recipe processes Grit; it does not produce the Grit.

items.name: Junk Heart Firebox
items.does: A formed Junk Heart multiblock can burn as an energy source and grants its owner crew Junk Heart knowledge.
use: Build the Junk Heart multiblock around the Firebox, form it, and activate its burner.
tips: The multiblock must be in FORMED state to count as running.

items.name: Hurl Tube
items.does: Hurl tubes form routes between stations; the configured ride uses 16 blocks per energy unit, 100 energy per unit, and speed 0.5.
use: Place face-adjacent tubes to connect Hurl Stations, then use a station to start a ride.
tips: Ride start validates the route, required energy, and station permissions.

items.name: Gutter Gear
items.does: When installed as a bodge, it multiplies machine energy use by 0.8.
use: Crouch and use it on a compatible machine; crouch-use toggles installation/removal.
tips: Machines support at most two bodges.

items.name: Tinker's Wrench
items.does: A wrench tool used on owned machines; machine interactions enforce owner-crew or override authorization.
use: Use the wrench on a machine to open its wrench action.
tips: Foreign-crew use is refused unless an override permission applies.

items.name: Glimmer Lens
items.does: Scans Glimmerwells, mobs, machines, ores, and crystals to grant crew Insight. A first mob scan grants 5 Insight, a first machine scan 8, and a first ore/crystal scan 4.
use: Use the Lens on a scannable target and complete its scan interaction.
tips: Repeated scans award one tenth of the base value, with a minimum of 1; Well scans have strength-based values.

items.name: Silver Grit
items.does: The furnace processing recipe consumes one Silver Grit and outputs one Ingredient_Bar_Silver.
use: Put one Silver Grit into the furnace recipe to produce one Silver Bar.
tips: The listed recipe processes Grit; it does not produce the Grit.

items.name: Blue paint daub
items.does: Marks a Gutterpipe branch blue.
use: Use it on the target Gutterpipe branch; the daub interaction sets the pipe colour.
tips: Colour affects pipe routing; the code recognizes red, blue, green, and yellow.

items.name: Red paint daub
items.does: Marks a Gutterpipe branch red.
use: Use it on the target Gutterpipe branch; the daub interaction sets the pipe colour.
tips: Colour affects pipe routing; the code recognizes red, blue, green, and yellow.

items.name: Tinker's Notebook
items.does: Stores crew notebook knowledge pages; eight page IDs and Junk Heart knowledge are required for Tinkered tier 2.
use: Use it to open the notebook and review unlocked pages.
tips: The delivery and Scrap Rush pages are earned through their respective systems.

items.name: Filled Gob-Jar
obtain: Capture a Tethered Well with an empty Gob-Jar
items.does: Stores the captured Well's temperament, strength, taste, and stability metadata.
use: Use it on a Well Cradle to seat the contained Well, or carry it to transport it.
tips: Carried jars lose 0.2 stability per second; damage removes 10 stability. At zero, a Well spawn is attempted before the jar is consumed.

items.name: Boom Valve
items.does: When installed, multiplies machine speed by 1.25 and Jank gain by 1.5.
use: Crouch and use it on a compatible machine; crouch-use toggles installation/removal.
tips: Machines support at most two bodges; extra speed comes with more Jank.

items.name: Hurl Station
items.does: Connects to Hurl Tubes and a Fizz network; using it starts travel through a validated route.
use: Connect face-adjacent tubes and a Fizz network, then use the Station to travel; use a wrench to rename it.
tips: Rides require route validity, enough energy, and permission for the station.

items.name: Gutterpipe
items.does: Moves items through a connected transport route; paint daubs set branch colours for sorting.
use: Place connected pipes, then daub a branch to assign its route colour.
tips: Colour names are red, blue, green, and yellow; the Snatcher Claw can filter by those colours.

items.name: Codex
items.does: Displays crew discoveries and Insight, including scanned Well, mob, machine, ore, and crystal information.
use: Use the Codex to open its crew research view.
tips: Repeated scans give 10% of base Insight, minimum 1.

items.name: Iron Grit
items.does: The furnace processing recipe consumes one Iron Grit and outputs one Ingredient_Bar_Iron.
use: Put one Iron Grit into the furnace recipe to produce one Iron Bar.
tips: The listed recipe processes Grit; it does not produce the Grit.

items.name: Green paint daub
items.does: Marks a Gutterpipe branch green.
use: Use it on the target Gutterpipe branch; the daub interaction sets the pipe colour.
tips: Colour affects pipe routing; the code recognizes red, blue, green, and yellow.

items.name: Grizzlecog's Receipt
items.does: A proof-of-delivery item; its language description says using it records the job.
use: Use the Receipt to record the delivery job.
tips: A Delivery notebook page is defined separately from the Scrap Rush page.

items.name: Scrap Plating Bodge
items.does: When installed, halves Jank gain.
use: Crouch and use it on a compatible machine; crouch-use toggles installation/removal.
tips: Machines support at most two bodges.

items.name: Spark Shard
items.does: A Sparkjaw drop; the drop definition allows one or two Shards.
use: Use it in a recipe or system that accepts Spark Shards; no consumer is identified in the inspected sources.
tips: No use recipe is listed in the extraction.

items.name: Onyxium Grit
items.does: The furnace processing recipe consumes one Onyxium Grit and outputs one Ingredient_Bar_Onyxium.
use: Put one Onyxium Grit into the furnace recipe to produce one Onyxium Bar.
tips: The listed recipe processes Grit; it does not produce the Grit.

items.name: Thorium Grit
items.does: The furnace processing recipe consumes one Thorium Grit and outputs one Ingredient_Bar_Thorium.
use: Put one Thorium Grit into the furnace recipe to produce one Thorium Bar.
tips: The listed recipe processes Grit; it does not produce the Grit.

items.name: Adamantite Grit
items.does: The furnace processing recipe consumes one Adamantite Grit and outputs one Ingredient_Bar_Adamantite.
use: Put one Adamantite Grit into the furnace recipe to produce one Adamantite Bar.
tips: The listed recipe processes Grit; it does not produce the Grit.

items.name: Tinker's Hammer
items.does: Used to straighten leaning Tether Stakes; authorization is checked against the Well claim crew, stake placer crew, or override permission.
use: Hit a leaning Tether Stake with the hammer to straighten it.
tips: A foreign crew without override permission cannot straighten the stake.

items.name: Boomshroom Burner
items.does: Burns fuel to produce Fizz energy; the energy system gates its processing by active area.
use: Place it, add supported fuel, and connect its output to the Fizz network.
tips: Crafting requires the matching Burner notebook page; machine production pauses in an inactive area.

items.name: Squawk Box
items.does: When installed, it enables machine alerts; Scrap Rush uses it to notify the crew when a raid steals machine output.
use: Crouch and use it on a compatible machine; crouch-use toggles installation/removal.
tips: Machines support at most two bodges.

items.name: Hurl Cannon
items.does: The item description instructs players to aim at a Catch Net within 64 blocks and climb aboard.
use: Place the cannon, aim toward a Catch Net within 64 blocks, and climb aboard.
tips: The item description says Boom Powder charges are coming soon.

items.name: Shroom Bed
items.does: A machine block that can host bodge slots; its energy member can be configured as a machine component.
use: Place the bed, then use its configured block interaction.
tips: Bodge installation uses crouch-use and is limited to two slots.

items.name: Mithril Grit
items.does: The furnace processing recipe consumes one Mithril Grit and outputs one Ingredient_Bar_Mithril.
use: Put one Mithril Grit into the furnace recipe to produce one Mithril Bar.
tips: The listed recipe processes Grit; it does not produce the Grit.

items.name: Tether Stake
items.does: Tethering needs 3 stakes for Flicker or Steady, 4 for Roaring, and 6 for Primal. Stake angles more than 40 degrees from even spacing are considered leaning.
use: Place stakes around a Dormant Well, distribute them evenly, then let the stake system evaluate the tether.
tips: The Well remains untethered if any required stake leans.

items.name: Copper Grit
items.does: The furnace processing recipe consumes one Copper Grit and outputs one Ingredient_Bar_Copper.
use: Put one Copper Grit into the furnace recipe to produce one Copper Bar.
tips: The listed recipe processes Grit; it does not produce the Grit.

items.name: Rattlewheel
items.does: A power machine that generates energy while running; Jank can make machines rattle at 40 points.
use: Place it and use its configured interaction to run it, then connect its output to a Fizz network.
tips: Running Jank rises by 0.25 per 20-tick cycle before modifiers; idle Jank decays by 0.1 per cycle.

items.name: Crackle Coil
items.does: Consumes 5 units of energy demand per solve and converts delivered energy into Dim Glimmer output, drawing from a burning Burner or formed Junk Heart below.
use: Place the Coil above a running Burner or formed Junk Heart and connect it to the energy network.
tips: It produces nothing when its area is inactive.

items.name: Glimmer Resonator
obtain: Workbench (Tinkering): 16 Scrap + 3 Iron Bar + 1 Cyan Crystal
items.does: Converts up to 40 delivered energy from a clear crystal into Dim Glimmer output. It clouds after 200 conversions by default.
use: Insert a crystal, connect the Resonator to an energy network, and clear it when it clouds.
tips: A clouded crystal stops output; inactive areas also stop conversion.

items.name: Glimmerwell Cradle
items.does: Seats a filled Gob-Jar in the air block above the Cradle and generates 4, 10, 25, or 40 energy for Flicker, Steady, Roaring, or Primal strength, multiplied by harmony from 0 to 5.
use: Place a filled Gob-Jar into the Cradle to seat its Well; place matching taste blocks nearby to increase harmony.
tips: The Cradle refuses placement if a Well already occupies the block above it.

items.name: Sloshtank
items.does: A fluid tank with a capacity registered by its fluid handler; the tank display updates once per second in an active area.
use: Place it and connect fluid pipes; use the fluid network to fill or drain it.
tips: Its visual fill state updates only in an active area and on the energy tick.

items.name: Gasbag
items.does: Stores up to 400,000 energy. Adjacent fire starts a leak that drains 1% of capacity per second; the bag can be patched.
use: Place it in the energy network; patch it after a fire-triggered leak.
tips: The leak is triggered by an adjacent fire fluid and only processes in active areas.

items.name: Gutter Boiler
items.does: Holds 4,000 water and consumes 10 water per second while active. It outputs 60 base power, boosted to 125% at pressure 80-95; pressure 100 pops the boiler.
use: Fill it with Water or Water_Source through a fluid connection, add fuel or lava below, then connect its output.
tips: Venting above pressure 95 drops pressure by 40; a Fizz Charge burns for 10 seconds.

mobs.name: Glimmer Wisp
mobs.where: The role asset is a passive bird-template variant; no survival spawn condition was found in the inspected branch sources. It can be spawned through the permission-gated mob command.
mobs.behaviour: Passive bird-template variant; wanders 12 blocks, at 2-6 blocks above ground, with 18 max health.

mobs.name: Sparkjaw
mobs.where: The role asset uses the Predator template; no survival spawn condition was found in the inspected branch sources. It can be spawned through the permission-gated mob command.
mobs.behaviour: Predatory melee role with 110 max health, 12-block view and alert ranges, 3-block attack distance, and 22 base physical damage with a 10% random modifier.

mobs.name: Riftmoth
mobs.where: The role asset uses the Void Spawn template; no survival spawn condition was found in the inspected branch sources. It can be spawned through the permission-gated mob command.
mobs.behaviour: Void-attitude role with 90 max health and 12-block view range. Riftmoth drains 20 stored energy per second when near a qualifying energy source.

mobs.name: Goblin Poacher
mobs.where: Scrap Rush raids spawn 1-5 Goblin Poachers around an eligible machine when the enabled schedule or command starts a raid; no ambient survival spawn condition was found.
mobs.behaviour: Goblin lobber role with 80 max health, 8-block view and attack distance, and maximum speed 3.
mobs.drops: Weighted drop entries: Scrap 1-2 at weight 90; Gob-Jar 1 at weight 10.

mobs.name: Vessa Lanternwright
mobs.where: Can spawn when a crew-tier-2 owned Burner or formed Junk Heart is running and a crystal trigger is within 8 blocks; the system spawns Vessa when there is a free air cell above the machine.
mobs.behaviour: Generic idle NPC; the role asset sets 70 max health and an Ignore default NPC attitude.
mobs.drops: No drop list is defined in the Vessa role asset.

mobs.name: Grizzlecog
mobs.where: Can be summoned by a player with the summon permission, while looking at a block within 8 blocks; the command places him above the targeted block.
mobs.behaviour: Trader NPC; its role asset links to the Craftory_Grizzlecog shop.
mobs.drops: The role asset references Drop_Klops_Merchant; no Craftory-specific drop list is assigned.

npcs.name: Grizzlecog
npcs.where: Summoned with `/craftory summon grizzlecog` by a player who has the command permission and looks at a block within 8 blocks.
npcs.role: Trader for the Grizzlecog shop; the NPC role links the Craftory_Grizzlecog trade asset.

npcs.name: Vessa
npcs.where: First Spark system may spawn her beside a running owned Burner or formed Junk Heart if the crew is tier 2 and a crystal trigger is within 8 blocks.
npcs.role: First Spark encounter NPC; a successful spawn records Vessa-met knowledge for the owner's crew.

systems.title: Fizz energy
facts: Energy is solved every 0.2 seconds.
Machine production and demand are registered in the shared energy network; over-grading and overload affect Jank.

systems.title: Machine Jank
facts: Jank updates on a 20-tick cycle: running gain is 0.25 and idle decay is 0.1.
Over-grading and overload each multiply gain by 2.0. Rattle starts at 40; fizzle chance starts at 2% at 70 and adds 0.2 percentage points per point above 70.
A fizzle stalls for 10 seconds and recovers at Jank 50; scrap repair removes 20 Jank.

systems.title: Bodge parts
facts: Machines accept at most two bodges.
Boom Valve: speed ×1.25 and Jank ×1.5; Gutter Gear: energy use ×0.8; Scrap Plating Bodge: Jank ×0.5; Squawk Box enables alerts; Muffler suppresses rattling.
Install or remove bodges with crouch-use on a compatible machine.

systems.title: Junk Heart multiblock
facts: A formed Junk Heart grants its owner crew the `craftory:heart/junk` knowledge.
The Junk Heart counts as running only while its burner is active and its multiblock state is FORMED.

systems.title: Crews
facts: Crew membership, invitations, and knowledge are keyed to player UUIDs; `/craftory crew` supports create, invite, accept, leave, kick, and info.
Crew names are limited to 32 characters.

systems.title: Tinker's Notebook
facts: The eight Tinkered pages are Burner, Crank, Canister, Gutterpipe, Gnasher, Oven, Grizzlecog delivery, and Scrap Rush.
The first six machine pages are associated with their respective machine type; Delivery and Scrap Rush are job pages.

systems.title: Crew tiers
facts: Tinkered tier is tier 2.
A crew reaches tier 2 only when it has all eight notebook page IDs and `craftory:heart/junk` knowledge.

systems.title: Scrap Rush
facts: Scrap Rush raids target eligible active-area machines; an enabled schedule or `/craftory scraprush start` can start a raid.
Raids spawn a configured 1-5 Goblin Poachers, and their defeat grants the Scrap Rush notebook page to the machine owner's crew.
A Goblin Poacher adjacent for the configured steal interval can mark the machine's Jank as stolen.

systems.title: Wakebell Anchor
facts: Default maximum Anchor charge is 240 minutes; setting the maximum to 0 prevents an active charge.
An active Anchor refreshes the surrounding 3-by-3 chunk area and removes its keep-loaded handles when charge runs out.

systems.title: Well births and scan
facts: Stormcall default interval is 180 seconds and chance 0.35; rain Flicker chance is 0.1, kill Flicker chance 0.05, and player Flicker cooldown 120 seconds.
Stormcall uses the strike position for the region cooldown, vane count within 64 blocks, and strong-Well regional budget.
The strong-Well budget defaults to one per region; region coordinates are `x shr 9` and `z shr 9`.

systems.title: Insight and Codex
facts: First Well read gives 20 points per strength ordinal plus 1, with a perfect read adding half of that base; repeat reads give 10% of base, minimum 1.
First mob, machine, and ore/crystal scans give 5, 8, and 4 Insight respectively; repeats use the same 10% decay with minimum 1.

systems.title: First Spark
facts: A running owned Burner or formed, burning Junk Heart can trigger First Spark for a crew at tier 2 when a crystal trigger is within 8 blocks.
The first Spark grants knowledge and attempts to spawn Vessa above the machine where an air cell is available.

systems.title: Cradle harmony
facts: Harmony counts matching blocks within four blocks in each axis and maps counts 0, 1-2, 3-5, 6-9, and 10+ to harmony 1-5.
Scrap taste matches Scrap plating; other taste strings match a block with that same ID.
Cradle output bases are 4/10/25/40 for Flicker/Steady/Roaring/Primal, multiplied by harmony 0-5.

systems.title: Storm Hunt and Glimmerwells
facts: Recognized storm IDs are `zone1_storm`, `zone2_thunder_storm`, `zone4_storm`, and `zone4_swamp_storm`; IDs containing `rain` classify as rain unless in the storm set.
Spark dislikes rain; Ember dislikes rain and recognized storms; other Temperaments have no weather penalty in the implemented rule.
Storm Steady chance is 0.15 plus 0.1 per nearby vane, capped at 0.55. Regions are 512 blocks wide on X and Z.
Tether stake counts are Flicker/Steady 3, Roaring 4, Primal 6. A Well must be DORMANT, meet the stake count, and have no leaning stakes to become TETHERED.
Capture uses 3 presses spaced 0.2-2 seconds apart.

systems.title: Jar carrier
facts: A carried filled jar slows base movement to 0.7× while not mounted; the component is present while a filled jar is carried.
Each jar loses 0.2 stability per second; damage removes 10 stability per instance; disliked weather removes 1 stability per 10 seconds.
At zero stability the carrier attempts a Wild Well spawn; the jar is consumed only after a successful spawn, otherwise it is retained at stability 1 for retry.

systems.title: Hurl transport
facts: Hurl uses 16 blocks per energy unit, 100 energy per unit, speed 0.5, lookahead 32, and a 200-tick fall guard by default.
A ride validates its route, energy, carrier status, and station permissions before starting.

systems.title: Gutterpipe sorting
facts: Red, blue, green, and yellow paint daubs set Gutterpipe branch colours.
The Snatcher Claw filters by item ID or daub colour; an empty-hand interaction clears its filter.

systems.title: Fluids and Gutter Boiler
facts: The Boiler accepts Water or Water_Source, stores at most 4,000 water, and consumes 10 per second while active.
Boiler pressure is capped at 100; base output is 60 and output is boosted to 125% at pressure 80-95. At pressure 100 the Boiler pops; venting above 95 drops pressure by 40.
Gasbag capacity is 400,000; adjacent fire triggers a leak draining 1% capacity per second.

systems.title: Commands
facts: See the `commands` array for registered syntax, player/permission requirements, and command effects.

commands.does: Displays Craftory version and loaded modules.

commands.cmd: /craftory crew create <name> | invite <player> | accept <crew-uuid> | leave | kick <player> | info [player]
commands.does: Manages crew membership and displays crew tier, pages, knowledge, and members.
Summons Grizzlecog above the block the player targets within 8 blocks.
Lists nearby Glimmerwells or spawns one at the targeted block within 8 blocks, falling back to the player's position.

commands.who: player with `hytale.command.craftory.scraprush`; Scrap Rush config must be enabled
commands.does: Starts a Scrap Rush at the nearest eligible machine.
Spawns a registered Craftory mob above the targeted block within 8 blocks; role aliases include glimmer_wisp, sparkjaw, riftmoth, and goblin_poacher.
Sets the maximum Wakebell Anchor charge time to a nonnegative number of minutes.
Grants a knowledge page to an online player.
Displays energy-network diagnostics for a targeted block within 8 blocks or explicit coordinates.
Runs Craftory runtime checks; intended for diagnostics rather than ordinary gameplay.

tiers.unlock: Default or item-specific tier is not assigned in the inspected item extraction; tier 0 in this file means unspecified, not a claimed in-game tier.
Tinkered tier is granted when the crew knows all eight notebook page IDs and Junk Heart knowledge (`craftory:heart/junk`).

strengths.name: Flicker
strengths.description: The weakest and most common. Catchable from Tier 3. Base Cradle output 4.

strengths.name: Steady
strengths.description: Rarer, usually from Stormcall strikes. Guarded, and must be calmed before tethering. Base output 10, up to grade 2.

strengths.name: Roaring
strengths.description: Base output 25, up to grade 3. Later tiers.

states.name: Wild
states.description: Newly born and restless. A Steady or stronger Well may have a Sparkjaw guardian.

states.name: Dormant
states.description: Calmed, by killing its guardian or by smothering it with three powered Fizz Dampers. Ready for Tether Stakes.

states.name: Tethered
states.description: Held by three evenly spaced Tether Stakes and claimed by your crew. Ready to jar.

states.name: Jarred
states.description: Sealed in a Gob-Jar and being carried home. Its Stability drains, so hurry.

states.name: Seated
states.description: Sitting on a Glimmerwell Cradle and producing Dim Glimmer.

states.name: Tapped
states.description: A Wellhead draws on it directly (coming in Storm Hunt part 2).

states.name: Corrupted
states.description: Riftmoths have fed on it, halving its output (coming in Storm Hunt part 2).

temperaments.name: Spark
temperaments.description: Dislikes plain rain, but loves a thunderstorm.

well_reference.note: While you carry a jarred Well in weather it dislikes, it loses 1 Stability every 10 seconds on top of the normal drain. For now every Temperament shares the same Taste: surround a seated Well with Scrap Plating to raise its Harmony (up to 5).

gaps: The extracted data contains 57 items, but several have no recipe, Grizzlecog trade, or mob drop: Fizz Charge, Snatcher Claw, all four Paint Daubs, Catch Net, Hurl Tube, Hurl Station, Hurl Cannon, Tether Stake, and the Grit items. These are marked with `No survival source found (creative/command only)` where no acquisition route was found.
Sloshtank, Gasbag, and Gutter Boiler have Grizzlecog trades in the #19 source branch, but the inspected union contains no craft recipe or drop for them.
The inspected code defines the Grit-to-metal-bar furnace conversions, but does not define a route that produces the Grit inputs themselves.

No survival spawn configuration was found for Glimmer Wisp, Sparkjaw, or Riftmoth in the inspected source paths; role assets and a permission-gated mob spawn command exist. Goblin Poacher is used by Scrap Rush.
Temperament has no per-temperament taste/like mapping in code; Glimmerwell's default taste is Scrap and Harmony currently maps that taste to Scrap Plating.
The item extraction does not encode item-specific tier numbers. `tier: 0` in item records means unspecified by the source data; the explicitly implemented crew progression is Tinkered tier 2.

No player-facing survival interaction for every Glimmerwell state is established by the state enum alone; WILD, DORMANT, TETHERED, JARRED, and SEATED are exercised by current runtime systems, while TAPPED, CORRUPTED, VOID_TOUCHED, and SPENT have no player-facing transition documented in the inspected sources.

lore.intro: Goblins have been dragging scrap out of the breaches for longer than anyone can remember, and some of it still hums. Craftory starts the day you buy a leaky goblin machine with a handful of Scrap. You learn to bodge your own. Then one of your machines makes a breach crystal sing, and a half-blind crystal archivist turns up to explain what you've done. From there scrap and crystal start to merge.

beats.title: The sealed crate
beats.text: Grizzlecog the goblin scrap peddler sells you a sealed crate. It opens with a puff, and the machine inside coughs to life. Sealed goblin junk: you can run it, but you don't understand it yet.

beats.title: Learning to bodge
beats.text: Take machines apart with a cracked Tinker's Wrench, fill your crew's Notebook, and hammer together your own Junk Heart. The goblins notice, and some of them come to take it.

beats.title: You made it sing
beats.text: Your machine whines, a nearby crystal answers with a pillar of light, and Vessa Lanternwright steps out of the glow: "You made it sing. With… a kettle?" The goblins back off: "Void-glass! Bad luck! …Sells though."

cast.name: Grizzlecog
cast.text: A goblin scrap peddler, and your first supplier. He trades in Scrap, and he takes it very seriously.

cast.name: Vessa Lanternwright
cast.text: A human crystal archivist who has spent her life listening to the breaches. She arrives the first time one of your machines makes a crystal sing.

cast.name: The Wellborn
cast.text: Creatures that form around Glimmerwells. They aren't evil. Vessa calls them "the world trying to sing".

lore.wells: A Glimmerwell is a living knot of light, born where the world's energy runs high: in thunderstorms, in rain and after big fights. Each one has a Temperament, a Strength and a Taste, the kind of place it wants to live.
